page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so the ends of several lines and the running head are incomplete; the running head shows only "I N I". The Greek word in "ὁμοιόμερα" and "πίθος" is read with doubt, and the Greek in the line "wibos cometa" is uncertain. The line "omnia qua" ends in a mark that could be a cut-off word. The line "Obsequens" may begin with a large initial O followed by a capital B. The entries "motum non esse irregularem" and "planetarum ordo" run together on one line in the print. The page numbers "210.211" and "211" are as printed. The left edge is cut, so the initial "I" of the running head "INDEX." is not visible; it is transcribed as printed in the visible part, "D E X.". The Greek word in the line "ϖωγωνίχε cometa 306" is only partly legible and is marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "de-" and "discri-" follows the dot-hyphen mark in the scan.
